description: Angular component for managing RuleChain entities in the Thingsboard platform, including form building, state updates, and UI logic.

classes.name: RuleChainComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent to handle RuleChain entities with specific UI and logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting ruleChainScope from configuration.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if delete option should be hidden based on configuration.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds a reactive form for editing RuleChain properties.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates the form with data from a RuleChain entity.

methods.name: onRuleChainIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when RuleChain ID is copied.

methods.name: isEdgeRootRuleChain
methods.description: Checks if the current RuleChain is the root for an edge.

methods.name: isAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Checks if the RuleChain is auto-assigned to an edge.

methods.name: isNotAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Checks if the RuleChain is not auto-assigned to an edge.
